name: Chilean Lake District
about: Summer (Dec–Mar) is best for the Villarrica volcano climb, lake swimming, and rafting; winter (May–Aug) is genuinely rainy — this side of the Andes catches far more Pacific moisture than the Argentine Lake District.
overview: Volcano country on Chile's side of the Andes — Pucón's adventure scene and Puerto Varas' German-influenced lakefront, ringed by rainforest.
costOverview: Everyday food is reasonable, but the marquee activities — the guided Villarrica volcano climb, hot-springs day passes, rafting — add up fast and are essentially expected on a first visit.
